# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **New engine and rendering fixes**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 adopts Skia m157 with native rendering fixes and explicit source-generated interop calling conventions. The managed API surface remains unchanged. Native updates address clipped paths, glyph replay, Graphite readback and Vulkan initialization.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check Graphite Metal runtime targets** — Graphite Metal adopts a native runtime minimum of iOS/tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. If using this backend, target a supported OS version. These backend minimums do not lower any higher requirements imposed by managed packages or frameworks. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m157** — Updates the native renderer to milestone 157 while preserving the existing glyph-bounds guard and managed API. The HarfBuzzSharp package revision becomes 14.4.0.200; the native shaping engine remains HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Path and glyph rendering** — Fixes convex anti-aliased path buffer overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and device-space path bounds. Corrects Graphite clip keys and wedge bounds, and validates direct-mask Slug data and unsupported fractional glyph replay. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **GPU transfer and initialization** — Corrects Graphite alpha-to-RGBx GPU-to-CPU transfer stride and initializes Vulkan render-pass pointers correctly. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Explicit cdecl source-generated interop** — Makes LibraryImport declarations use the same cdecl convention as existing DllImport and delegate paths, correcting an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86. Runtime validation of the reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp source-generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing interop paths. This corrects a potential Windows x86 ABI mismatch; runtime validation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.
